name: Lucky Pigsy
description: Bajie, whose dharma name is Wu Neng, is the second disciple of Tang Monk in "Journey to the West". Together with Sun Wukong and Sha Monk, he protected Tang Monk in his quest for Buddhist scriptures from the West, and was eventually named the Messenger of the Pure Altar. He is proficient in the Thirty-six Transformations and can soar into the clouds and mist. His exclusive weapon is the Supreme Qinjin Rake, commonly known as the Nine-Tooth Nail Rake, which was made by Taishang Laojun and given by the Jade Emperor himself. Because of his honest appearance, straightforward personality, humor, broad-mindedness and fat body, he is deeply loved by the general public. Although he looks clumsy, he is a representative of courage but timidity and great wisdom but also foolishness.
